scope: Prepared engine checks across a three-client run and a fresh two-hero run. NPCs are repositioned and their attacks paused/others anchored away, using a fixed diagnostic BindableFunction. Walker damage/death, weapon pickup/swing/transfer and NPC defeat use actual keyboard/touch inputs. One first-run lifecycle death prepares Normal shield, light/heavy target hits are existing Session:_hit calls, and boss progression/one ground ball are prepared to isolate hand priority. No HP/reserve values are directly edited. Not a natural full-level walkthrough, physical device test or actual reconnect.

preparationHook:
-- Fixed prepared acceptance actions only, omitted from repository entry and build.
local qa=Instance.new('BindableFunction');qa.Name='BrickToadsClubQA';qa.Parent=game.ServerStorage
qa.OnInvoke=function(action)
 local c=controller.groups['group-1'].controller;local w=c.world;local s=c.current;local d=c.director
 local function pose(id,x,z,forward)
  local a=w.actors[id];a.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(x,3,z),Vector3.new(x+(forward or 1),3,z)))
  a.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
 end
 if action=='walker' then
  d.enemies[-3].nextAttack=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+3600;d.enemies[-3].windup=nil
  for id,a in w.actors do if id<0 and id~=-3 then a.root.Anchored=true;a.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-10,3,id==-1 and 20 or -20)) end end
  pose(1,-65,-7);pose(2,-75,7);pose(-3,-59.5,-7,-1)
 elseif action=='walkerFinish' then pose(1,-65,-7);pose(-3,-60,-7,-1)
 elseif action=='respawnPickup' then
  s:_die(1,'PreparedPickupShield');task.wait(.15)
  local item;for _,row in d.clubs.items do if row.state=='Ground' then item=row;break end end
  assert(item);pose(1,item.position.x-3,item.position.z,-1)
 elseif action=='friendly' then pose(1,-65,-7);pose(2,-58,-7,-1)
 elseif action=='light' then s:_hit(-1,1,'Punch')
 elseif action=='heavyEnemy' then
  pose(1,-65,-7);pose(2,-75,15);w.actors[-1].root.Anchored=false;pose(-1,-60.5,-7,-1)
  d.enemies[-1].nextAttack=workspace:GetServerTimeNow();d.enemies[-1].windup=nil
 elseif action=='heavy' then s:_hit(-1,1,'Dash')
 elseif action=='pickup2' then
  local item;for _,row in d.clubs.items do if row.state=='Ground' then item=row;break end end
  assert(item);pose(1,-75,-15);pose(2,item.position.x-2,item.position.z,-1)
 elseif action=='pig' then
  w.actors[-1].root.Anchored=false;d.enemies[-1].nextAttack=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+30
  pose(1,-75,15);pose(2,-65,-7);pose(-1,-58,-7,-1)
 elseif action=='boss' then
  pose(1,600,15);pose(2,600,0);d.zoneIndex=7;w:progress(7,false);d:_boss()
  d.guardian.nextShot=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+30;d.nextShot=d.guardian.nextShot
 elseif action=='groundBall' then
  d.serial+=1;local id=-1000-d.serial;local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
  local point=w:groundPosition(w:position(2));assert(point)
  d.projectiles[id]={mode='Ground',position=point,created=now,expiresAt=now+20}
  w:projectile(id,point,false,'Ground')
 end
 local items={};for id,row in d.clubs.items do items[id]={state=row.state,position=row.position,slot=row.slot,sourceActorId=row.sourceActorId}end
 local holders={};for slot,row in d.clubs.equipment do holders[tostring(slot)]={id=row.item.id,actorId=row.actorId}end
 local bodies={}
 for _,id in {1,2,-1,-3} do local a=w.actors[id];if a then local p=a.root.Position
  local _,y,_=a.root.CFrame:ToOrientation()
  bodies[tostring(id)]={position={p.X,p.Y,p.Z},actorId=a.model:GetAttribute('ActorId'),weapon=a.model:GetAttribute('EquippedClub'),yaw=y,health=a.humanoid.Health}
 end end
 local role=d:controlled(-3)
 return game.HttpService:JSONEncode({state=s:snapshot(),level=d:snapshot(),logs=s.logs,items=items,holders=holders,bodies=bodies,
  groundModels=#w.clubItemFolder:GetChildren(),enemyRole=role,walker={health=d.enemies[-3].health,dead=d.enemies[-3].dead,actorId=d.enemies[-3].actorId},ballCarriers=d.guardian and d.guardian.carriers})
end

notes.preflight: An initial wrong-offer click and unpaused Walker allowed natural damage; that preflight is excluded from acceptance.
notes.earlyRead: First friendly-fire inspector ran before swing effect. The later real Hit log at profile20 confirms raw47→31; the early read is retained below.
notes.shield: Pickup retained actual Normal shield. That shield expired before the later swing, so shield removal-before-swing is native proof rather than claimed engine proof.
notes.disconnect: Two clients disconnected from the three-client session. Their IDs were not reused; remaining checks used a fresh two-hero session. No successful reconnect is claimed.
